text: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited's voting ordinary shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol NTB and on the Bermuda Stock Exchange under the symbol NTB.BH.
short: Butterfield is listed on the NYSE (NTB) and the Bermuda Stock Exchange (NTB.BH)

source.name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited Form 20-F FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The Bank's common shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "NTB" and on the Bermuda Stock Exchange ("BSX") under the symbol "NTB.BH".
